settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account, preferences, and privacy.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the app. Changes apply immediately and are remembered on this device.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control which notifications you receive in-app.
notifications.challengeUpdatesDesc: Approvals and assignment updates for challenges you're involved in.
notifications.projectUpdatesDesc: Milestone completions and other project activity.
notifications.collaborationRequestsDesc: Industry interest expressed in your projects.
notifications.emailNotificationsDesc: Preference is saved, but this platform does not send emails yet — nothing will be emailed until that's built.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.passwordHint: Change your password from the Account section.
privacy.logoutAllConfirm: This will end every active session on every device, including this one. Continue?
privacy.profileVisibilityDesc: Controls whether your name is shown to universities, industry, or government accounts viewing a challenge you submitted.
privacy.showContactInfoDesc: When on, your email is visible to universities/industry/government viewing your submitted challenges.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: These changes apply immediately across the whole app and are remembered on this device.
accessibility.reduceMotionDesc: Removes transitions and animations throughout the app.
accessibility.highContrastDesc: Increases the contrast between text/borders and the background.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. Your account and associated personal data will be permanently removed or anonymized according to the platform's data-handling rules.
